title: The balance on a future date
description: A calendar of income and payments with a calculated balance. Any amount can be opened down to the transactions behind it and recalculated after the plan changes.

blocks.text: The balance today doesn’t show what will happen after the rent and the next income. One review values a calendar where the forecast of available funds is visible day by day. That view helps to spot the gap between an expense and the income expected.

quote.text: This is the only bill and income tracking system that truly allows you to easily see your available forecasted funds, literally day by day on a calendar!  Please don’t change anything!

blocks.text: Separate the completed transactions from the planned ones. For a chosen date, show the chain that produced the amount. Allow the date or the amount of a future payment to be changed temporarily, keeping the original scenario for comparison.

Move one incoming payment to a later day and check the calculation by hand. The person should see which days changed and why. The forecast depends on how complete the plan is; a precise-looking number doesn’t make a future payment guaranteed.
